name: manual_fceb7a
claim: When the Mac peer path fails, dial the saved discovery host on HTTPS port 8443 with the approved issuer certificate, not backend port 8002, the model port, or a retired leaf pin. Order is TCP, pinned health 200, unauthenticated inbox 401, authenticated inbox 200, then one receipt. A process environment pin overrides the user pin. Windows curl ignores a PEM CA file; use the pinned Python peer client.

decisions.notes: On 2026-11-23 the helper defaulted to the loopback backend, the process still trusted the retired leaf, and a fresh client had TLS unset. Health 200 then inbox 401 and 200 restored delivery. Receipt means ok true, received_at, and matching bytes.
